pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Leave Wet Hay under open sky in a hot biome. An unsuitable climate returns ordinary hay; no full season needs to pass.

pages.title: Dry hay into beach roofing
pages.text: Wet a Hay Bale and leave it under open sky in a hot biome. Suitable conditions produce Thatch; unsuitable ones can return ordinary hay.

pages.title: Harvest a palm coconut
pages.text: Bone Meal on palm leaves with air beneath helps grow coconuts. Throw a mature coconut to open it; falling fruit can hit anything standing underneath.
